requests.prompt:
Precisely edit the supplied original wuxia pixel art sprite sheet on chroma green. Output the same square 4 by 4 sheet of exactly sixteen isolated complete drawings, in same cell order and scale. Flat pure #00ff00 background, generous gutters, no captions, effects, or shadows. Preserve identity, body proportions, pixels style, charcoal Hắc Thiết robes, beige fur, red sash, boots, hair, camera angle, gait and arm action of the original wherever possible. Keep one long brown wrapped handle of the same length. Enlarge the single gray iron hammer head by 35 percent in linear dimensions in ALL sixteen cells, including standing and walking, with the same block shape, copper Y-inlay, dark facets and no spikes. Enlarge relative to the fixed character body and shaft diameter; the head should now visibly have real weight. Keep each whole hammer safely inside its cell; no duplicate hammer or overlapping cell.
VERY IMPORTANT: Change all four close combat pose drawings in row THREE (third from top) to a firm TWO HANDED grip. BOTH hands must firmly grasp the SAME visible hammer handle, separated by a palm or more, in EACH of these four drawings. Show two recognizable closed hands touching the wood, not an empty fist or palm. Keep their gestures distinct from one another: 1 straight forward thrust at chest height with both hands in line on the shaft; 2 lateral SWEEP TO HIS LEFT at waist height with turned shoulders and both hands still gripped; 3 rising lift, a strong LOW-TO-HIGH swing finishing raised, both hands on the diagonal shaft; 4 overhead smash landing on the ground ahead with a crouch, hands separated on shaft and head low. These are still body keyframes. Preserve the two idle and two guard cels of row 1, the four alternating steps of row 2, and the four ranged aim/recovery cels of row 4. Those non-melee cels can continue using their original one-hand grip. Ensure feet and hammer heads are all completely visible, with blank green padding all around.
All cels face east, screen right

Draw an isolated 4-column by 4-row sprite effect source, square image, evenly spaced equal cells. Only sharp pixel-art BRANCHED LIGHTNING in a warm gold-white palette with white cores and soft amber edges. No purple, red, magenta, fire, painted swishes, smooth gradients, captions, borders, symbols, shadows, weapons or people. The background is uniformly pure green #00ff00. Draw original electrical discharges with jagged irregular forked lines and visible gaps, clean enough to read at roughly 80 to 110 game pixels. Each row is FOUR distinct chronological phases of a single attack effect, progressing left to right (charging small, striking full extent, fragmenting, fading as a few sparks). Each cel has lots of pure green margin on all four sides, absolutely no artifacts crossing a cell boundary. Row 1: a narrow horizontal electrically forked lance shooting to the RIGHT, near-horizontal and jagged. Row 2: a shallow wide C-shaped SWEEP along a horizontal ground arc, formed by forked lightning filaments, no solid filled crescent. Row 3: an ascending angular lightning hook from lower left to upper right like the trajectory of a rising hammer. Row 4: an overhead downward hook toward the lower right, the very end aimed toward the ground with a few forks. The largest phase in each row is the second image, all full phases visually distinct. This is wuxia pixel art with crisp electrical forks.

Localized palette edit to this four-frame green background ground-lightning sprite strip. Keep the entire exact 4-cell horizontal strip, outlines, pixels, positions and timing drawings. Repaint all violet, pink and purple electrical pixels in the four bursts to old-style warm yellow and white electricity: deep amber at the darkest edges, saturated gold at mid values, creamy yellow and white in the bright branching cores. Keep the flat pure chroma green field for extraction. Do not add any effects or text.

Replace exactly row 3 of the input with four corrected action cels, all still seen from BEHIND. Keep the 4x4 green grid, dimensions, the other twelve cels, and the same warm realistic pixel-art palette and character. Each of the four actions MUST show BOTH fists side-by-side on the SAME long brown shaft with steel head, just like a two-handed baseball swing. Never leave a free arm dangling and never show a free hand. Make this visible from behind by having both bent arms emerge on ONE SIDE of the torso in each cell, with two distinct skin-colored fists spaced on the shaft. 1: two-handed straight northward thrust, torso rotated slightly toward screen right, shaft leaning up toward top-right in projection, hand nearest head clear and both wrists visible. 2: two-handed leftward horizontal sweep, body twisted left so both hands are on the left of the torso, from head at far left to both hands and butt at right. 3: strong rising lift to the upper right with both arms high on shaft. 4: deep crouched downward slam angling the shaft to lower right, both arms reach forward and both fists close around the shaft. The rear three-quarter camera can see the near shoulder during a twist but does not see the face. Keep 8–20 pixels of clean green minimum around each cell, especially around the hammer heads at edges and the bottom row's raised weapon.

Precisely edit row THREE column TWO of this four by four green sprite sheet. The second attack, a leftward sweep, currently has only one hand visibly on the shaft. In that one cel draw two unmistakable closed skin-colored fists gripping the SAME exposed long shaft, spaced a palm apart like a batter swinging. Draw both wrists and their copper bands so the grip reads clearly at small sprite scale. No free arm behind his back. Keep head to screen left, keep all fifteen other cels unchanged. Leave clean green gutters around the corrected cel. Keep the entire square original sprite sheet in frame.

Create a WIDE 2:1 pixel art wuxia sprite sheet on pure #00ff00 with exactly four columns and two rows. Input reference shows Hắc Thiết Côn Luân Thiền Sư with his dark clothes, red sash, broad pale fur and long chestnut hammer with large dark iron copper-inlaid head. Match this design and small strong chibi anatomy exactly. For each cell show the complete same hero with BOTH hands visibly gripping ONE long hammer; two hands spaced along same shaft. Front to back row order is important. EACH ROW's direction sequence is DOWN FRONT, LEFT PROFILE, RIGHT PROFILE, UP BACK. Top row in all 4 directions: low ready, broad stance, hammer at hip level with shaft across front, two hands visible. Bottom row in all 4 directions: overhead anticipation, holds hammer head above and a little behind shoulder, BOTH hands grip the same shaft over head ready to slam, bend knees, do not show face in the back view. Fixed RPG orthographic top-down three-quarter camera. Keep cels clear of all borders. The figures must occupy similar scale and be well centered with plenty of green margin on all edges in their respective cells. No shadows, text, lines or effects, full original pixel art character on flat pure green.

provenance: Original project art derived from the director-approved Hắc Thiết concept and the prior prototype. Ranged bolt pixels from v01. Q coil from v02.
